freePlan.limits: Community edition: max resolution 1024x1024, no commercial use, no tiled builds, no Unreal Engine or Houdini integration, no macros.

keyLimits.en: Max resolution 1024x1024, non-commercial use only, no macros, no Unreal Engine/Houdini integration.
Max resolution 8192x8192, commercial use permitted, node-locked license on up to 2 computers, no Houdini support, no macro creation.
Max resolution 16,384x16,384 (up to 262,144x262,144 with tiles), limited automation, Houdini support, macro creation, node-locked license, revenue must be under $1M/year.
Same max resolution as Professional, full automation workflow, transferable (movable) license within a company, required for revenue over $1M/year.

cautions.en: Licenses are one-time (perpetual) purchases, node-locked by default; floating or offline licensing is only available on higher tiers, not on Indie.
Commercial eligibility depends on company revenue: Professional is capped under $1M/year revenue, above that Enterprise is required.

capabilities.en: Node-based procedural 3D terrain generator used as a standard for landscape and environment creation.
Supports tiled builds at very high resolution (up to 262,144x262,144) on the Professional and Enterprise editions.
Integrates with Unreal Engine and Houdini on paid editions (Houdini support from Professional up).
Macro creation and automation workflows available from Professional (limited) and Enterprise (full).

limitations.en: Free Community edition is capped at 1024x1024 resolution and forbids commercial use entirely.
Indie edition, the cheapest commercial tier, has no Houdini support and cannot create macros, only use them.
Node-locked licensing is the default across tiers; floating/offline licenses are not available on Indie.
Commercial use above $1M annual company revenue legally requires the more expensive Enterprise edition regardless of feature needs.

reason.en: Free general-purpose 3D suite that can also build terrains via add-ons, at zero cost.
Node-based procedural tool with broader scope than terrain, used alongside or instead of Gaea in VFX pipelines.
